Corollary
[Orthogonal decomposition of Jacobi fields] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0305, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0306 ↗ appb-lem-jacobi-equation 1. Corollary B.14\group local-comparison-geometry

Every Jacobi field $J$ along a geodesic with unit tangent vector $T$ decomposes uniquely as \[ J = J_0 + (at+b)T, \] where $a,b\in \mathbb R$ and $\langle J_0,T\rangle \equiv 0$.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0306 \sketch The component of $J$ along the geodesic direction has vanishing second derivative, so it must be affine in the arclength parameter.

□
